name: Wenchang LC-101
tagline: China's heavy-lift pad — Long March 5 to Tianhe, Chang'e 5/6, Tianwen-1, and the lunar return programme
description: Built in 2014, operational from 2016, on Hainan Island at 19.6°N — the southernmost CNSA launch site. The low latitude adds about 460 m/s of free eastward velocity vs Jiuquan or Xichang, which is how Long March 5B can reach the 25-tonne LEO class needed to put the Tianhe core module into orbit in a single launch. Wenchang LC-101 is dedicated to Long March 5 / 5B; maiden flight November 3, 2016. It also flew Chang'e 5 (lunar sample return, 2020), Chang'e 6 (the farside sample return, 2024), and Tianwen-1 (Mars orbiter + Zhurong rover, 2020). Sister pad LC-201 next door handles Long March 7/8 manifests and achieved its first launch in June 2016.
best_known_for: China's heavy-lift pad — Long March 5 to Tianhe, Chang'e 5/6, Tianwen-1, and the lunar return programme
